pages.title: Decision pathways
pages.description: Recommendation: retain optionality now. Evaluate renewal and a pre-expiry sale concurrently, but authorize neither solely on regional data. These are analyst decision rules, not official investment recommendations.

cells: A verified after-tax offer beats the risk-adjusted value of continued income and alternatives.
Transaction tax and costs, reinvestment risk, lost rent upside. Obtain actual pricing; no sale value or optimal year established.
Documented tenant credit, enforceable obligations, acceptable rent and expense allocation support holding.
Weak guarantees, below-market locked rent, concessions and continuing concentration. Confirm options and tenant consent first.
Contractual income, liquidity and insured downside are independently established and attractive relative to sale.
Shortening remaining term, default, residual costs and expiry vacancy; do not wait blindly for expiration.
A signed creditworthy extension improves actual bids enough to offset concessions and costs.
No guaranteed cap-rate compression; extension may reduce flexibility or lock poor economics. Compare actual bids.
Documented alternate demand and permitted use justify vacancy and capital spending.
Downtime, incentives, commissions, buildout and use restrictions; entitlement and budget gate required.
Verified legal feasibility and independently costed residual land value exceed existing-use value.
Construction, environmental, financing and permitting risk; not the default wealth-preservation route.
Qualified business/investment real-property exchange is suitable after tax/legal review.
Deferral is not tax elimination; eligibility and execution constraints, replacement concentration and price risk remain.
